notes: Relationship → soft AI / micro consequences. Not G0. Bond ranks from pairBonds (C<25, B<55, A≥55). Effects shadow IntentResolver / unit_behavior — never densify, never god-mode. Cultivated motifs (spot meets siege, supply meets hunger) are preferred triggers.
law: Human seal before retuning combat feel
Soft bias only — kite/avoid cones, bark hints, mark preference
Requires co-deployed pair on the field + bond rank gate
Dark / missing pairBond → no augment (honest absence)
Do not replace BeliefField / kiln plod / player orders

augments.title: Knock cadence
augments.pitch: Scouts learn to dodge friendly Fatboy / Tzar splash as bond rises — timing from hearth talks becomes micro.

effect.note: Spotter packs step out of Fatboy/Tzar knock cones a beat early; arty does not stop firing.

augments.title: Eyes for the wall
augments.pitch: High bond spotter→siege: scout marks / fog pushes bias the plod target toward what the eyes already painted.

effect.note: Siege preferDefenses / push soft-weights toward spotter-revealed statics and marked hinges.

augments.title: Same circle, different tooth
augments.pitch: Warder↔Commando: dirty tooth seeds approaches inside the beamer circle; exit lanes stay clean.

effect.note: Trap/mine assist prefers annulus inside Warder/Nox pad radius; extract corridor unmarked.

augments.title: Feed the roast
augments.pitch: Hearth/Lumen/Solarium bond with Kiln/Bro/Fatboy: eco stall / energy deficit soft-holds siege push until surplus recovers.

effect.note: On energy drought, hunger plod pushBias dips briefly; supply craftBias rises — then release.

augments.title: In-Drop support bark
augments.pitch: Light HUD/bark when a high-η couple shares the field — keyed off cognifold/support couple, not a second AI.

effect.note: One-liner from camp talk motif; no gameplay power.
